extras.name: Wan-AI/Wan2.2-I2V-A14B
extras.note: STUDY-051 doc — Single-GPU I2V command uses `--offload_model True --convert_model_dtype` and states it **can run on a GPU with at least 80GB VRAM**. **Refuses a native 32 GB floor** on this card.

extras.name: Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B
extras.note: STUDY-051 doc — Single-GPU TI2V with offload/`t5_cpu` states **at least 24GB VRAM (e.g. RTX 4090)**; notes ≥80GB can drop offload flags for speed. **States a ≤32 GB-class floor** for the 5B path.

extras.name: Wan-AI/Wan2.2-S2V-14B
extras.note: STUDY-051 doc — S2V single-GPU command: **at least 80GB VRAM**. Peer A14B-class card that **refuses 32 GB** as the documented single-GPU requirement.

extras.name: tencent/HunyuanVideo-1.5
extras.note: STUDY-051 doc — System Requirements: **Minimum GPU Memory: 14 GB (with model offloading enabled)**; Diffusers snippet uses `enable_model_cpu_offload` + VAE tiling. **States a 32 GB–compatible floor** under offload.

extras.name: lightx2v/Wan2.2-Distill-Models
extras.note: STUDY-051 doc — Catalog: BF16 `lightx2v_4step` **~28.6 GB**; FP8/INT8 / ComfyUI FP8 **~15 GB**; “Memory Efficient” + configs labeled **80GB+** and **24GB+** GPUs. Quant sizes on page — not a measured 5090 GB invent.
